rule: Recorded for later governed correction only. This package does NOT close, rename, merge or delete any canonical venue.

identity_evidence.reason: Theatres Trust database entry for Airdrie Arts Centre, Anderson Street, Airdrie - a Carnegie library converted to an arts centre in 1967 which CLOSED IN 2012. identity_evidence.reason: Fetched. identity_evidence.reason: Search results confirm the venue at 24-34 North Bridge Street, Bathgate EH48 4PS - an exact match to the OSM address - now trading as the 'Reconnect Regal Theatre', run by Reconnect Charity, 230 seated / 400 standing, tel 01506 630085. Pages not fetched.

identity_evidence.reason: Search result summary: Silvergate Leisure took over Moka & Shack on Silver Street in 2018 and rebranded the floors as Void and Level. Not independently fetched.
Search result summary: City of Lincoln Council approved conversion of the Level nightclub building to student housing (July 2026). Not independently fetched.

venues.notes: OSM name 'Moka and Shack' is historic. Site rebranded Void/Level in 2018; Level closed and building approved for student-housing conversion in 2026. Evidence is search-snippet level only (news sites not fetched), hence MEDIUM.

identity_evidence.reason: FETCHED: agent listing titled 'Former Tokyo Nightclub', 18 Silver Street, Lincoln LN2 1EW, freehold for sale at GBP 2,250,000, 960 capacity, 4 trade rooms. Matches the OSM address exactly. No closure date stated.

venues.notes: OSM name is misspelled 'Toyko'. Building (the former Constitutional Club) is being marketed for sale as a former nightclub; a Skiddle venue page still exists but that is historic. Exact closure date not established - do not assume one.

identity_evidence.reason: FETCHED: the organisation's own site states it has 'surrendered our theatre building' and now gives a registered address of 11 Market Place, SE16 3UQ. The OSM building at (51.4800, -0.0983), Bethwin Road, Camberwell, is therefore no longer a theatre venue.

identity_evidence.reason: FETCHED: the organisation is live and still operates a venue, but its stated address is now '4 Murrain Road N4 2BN' on the Kings Crescent Estate - NOT the Amhurst Terrace address in the OSM row. The OSM coordinates (51.5548, -0.0675) point at the old Amhurst Terrace site.

venues.notes: The company has MOVED: the OSM Amhurst Terrace location is stale; its current base is 4 Murrain Road N4 2BN. Recorded as RENAMED_OR_REPLACED because the venue at these coordinates is no longer Hackney Showroom. The official site is still the right source for the company.
